RetroWrite II 2.2 for the enhanced Apple IIe (128K, mouse, ProDOS 8 hard disk).

**New: ODT documents.** Save As writes OpenDocument Text (`.ODT`) that LibreOffice, OpenOffice and Word open, and Open reads `.ODT` files made by them: fonts, sizes, bold, italic, underline, superscript and subscript, alignment, line spacing, tabs, margins, page breaks, header and footer carry across. A name typed without a period gets `.ODT` added; any other ending (such as `LETTER.RW`) saves RetroWrite II's own format.

**Also in this release**
- Menus: clicking a title and letting go keeps the menu open, and the pointer now moves into it and highlights items (it used to freeze, as seen in Virtual ][).
- Typing in a text box no longer presses a button that starts with the same letter.
- A new Owner's Manual, in the same design as the RetroDB and RetroCALC manuals.

**Downloads**
- `RetroWrite-II-2.2.zip`: the program files (`RW2.SYSTEM`, `RW2.MAIN`, `RW2.LC`, `RW2.FONTS`, `RW2.OVL1`-`RW2.OVLB`, `RW2.SPLASH`, `SPELL.DICT`, `TUTORIAL`, `GLOSSARY`, the sample `LETTER`), the disk-image installer and the manual. See the README for the ProDOS file types, or install onto a disk image with `python3 install_rw2.py MYDISK.po --ac path/to/ac.jar --files .` ([AppleCommander](https://applecommander.github.io/) needed).
- `RetroWrite-II-Owners-Manual.pdf`: the manual.

Tested in the apple2js emulator; not yet on real hardware.
